info.title: VisiConvert public API
info.description: Workspace-scoped API for hosted and self-hosted integrations. Bearer keys are created in the workspace API keys screen. Keys cannot administer credentials, billing, or keys. Hosted requests fail closed when Rails access verification is unavailable. /leads aliases /interactions. Lists of inquiries, interactions and bookings use keyset pagination; numbers and source reports return arrays. No automatic request retries.

InquiryDetail.description: Inquiry, original interactions and latest 100 history entries; qualification/notes/version are shared by the inquiry.

TwilioStatus.description: Connection status, revision and callback URLs. Never includes provider secrets.

origin.description: Exact HTTPS origin without path, query, fragment or wildcard; HTTP only for localhost.

version.description: 0 for creation; current list_sites version for updates. Stale updates return 409.

Site.description: Website settings and historical session_count, form_count, last_session_at and last_form_at. Browser-reported activity is not proof of authenticity.

origin.description: Exact HTTPS origin without path, query, fragment or wildcard; HTTP only for localhost.

version.description: 0 for creation; current list_sites version for updates. Stale updates return 409.

fallback_phone.description: US E.164 business destination shared by every pool number; never a registered tracking number.

version.description: 0 for absent pool; current pool version for updates.

dedicated_numbers.description: Explicit acknowledgement required to enable a pool.

Pool.description: Pool configuration (null if absent), available numbers and last 50 assignments. Use pool.version for updates; removed numbers revoke assignments.

Setup.description: Historical setup evidence, not a live health guarantee. Sites include pool configuration and last assignment; numbers include call_count and last_call_at. No contact fields or provider credentials. get_status/connection endpoints separately report provider readiness.
